alibabacloud-oss-image-processing-diagnosis v0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Provides read-only diagnostics for Alibaba Cloud OSS image processing issues, including problems like x-oss-process errors, watermarking failures, forced downloads, image style failures, WebP/HEIC errors, and original image protection 403s.
- All diagnostics are performed strictly via prebuilt scripts; direct SDK/API/command execution is prohibited.
- Never accepts or exposes credentials; scripts use environment-based credential resolution only.
- Only draws conclusions based on actual script results—never fabricates causes or details.
- Out of scope for transfer errors, endpoint issues, billing, presigned URLs, direct-access links, static hosting, videos, blind watermarks, and document preview.
- Enforces detailed reporting, strict boundaries, and official doc citation for all supported diagnosis topics.
